rounds.kill_strategy: Use upper triangular matrices with deterministic values (e.g., all 1.0s). The expected result for triu(ones) @ triu(ones) is predictable: C[i][j] = j-i+1 for j>=i. The garbage values from out-of-bounds reads will cause large deviations from this expected pattern.
